pages.name: Slav: Dutch, 8...O-O 9.Qe2 Nbd7 10.e4 Bg6 11.Bd3 h6
pages.notes: Plan 1 gave an impossible f2-f4-f5 push (knight on f3); replaced with Rd1/Re1 and e5. British spelling elsewhere.

pages.name: Slav: Dutch, 8...O-O 9.Qe2 Nbd7 10.e4 Bg6 11.Bd3 Re8
pages.notes: Plan 1 gave f2-f4-f5 with the knight on f3; plan 2 said ...Qa5 presses d4. Rewrote both (e5 Nf6-kick; ...e5 break, ...Nf8, ...Bh5 pin); British spelling.

pages.name: Slav: Dutch, 8...O-O 9.Qe2 Ne4
pages.notes: Plan 1 traded on e4 with a c4-bishop that cannot reach it and pressed a d5-pawn Black does not have. Rewrote both plans; overview now says what 9...Ne4 does; British spelling.

pages.name: QGA: 3.e3 e5
pages.notes: Overview called the structure symmetrical; plan 3 called the d-file open with a pawn on d4. Rewrote overview and plans (isolated d4-pawn, block the check, e-file and d5); British spelling.

pages.name: QGA: 3.e3 e6
pages.notes: Plan 1 put the isolated pawn and a minority attack in Black's camp; plans used 0-0 and Be2/d3 shorthand. Rewrote both plans; British spelling.

pages.name: QGA: 3.e4 e5 4.Nf3 Bb4+
pages.notes: Plan 1 was vague; plan 2 wrote Nc3 as a Black move. Rewrote both (block with Bd2/Nc3, regain c4; ...exd4 and the pin).

pages.name: QGA: 3.Nc3 e6 4.e4
pages.notes: Plan 1 used Be2/d3 shorthand; rewrote it; British spelling elsewhere.

pages.name: QGA: 3.Nc3 Nf6
pages.notes: Plan 1 wrote the centre as a d4-e4 route; plan 2 missed the ...e5 counter. Rewrote both; British spelling.

pages.name: Queen's Gambit Accepted: Accelerated Mannheim Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 sent the queen to d3 or c2 and named Be2 loosely; rewrote both plans (Qxc4, blocks ...c6/...Nc6, time against the queen).

pages.name: Queen's Gambit Accepted: Old Variation, Billinger Gambit
pages.notes: Overview said 6.a3 stops a ...Bb4 pin; it stops ...Qb4+ and ...Bb4+. Plan 3 castled with the f8-bishop still home. Fixed both; British spelling.
